verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs say outputs can be annotated through annotation queues, and list human review as an evaluator type, so the core capability exists. The evidence is a single thin mention: nothing shows how outputs get routed into queues (automation rules exist generically but are not tied to queues), nor how reviewers label items. Missing for 10: documented routing of traces or outputs into queues (manual or rule-based), queue workflow and labeling-schema details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can route outputs to human annotation queues for review and labeling
